study: review-informed post-baseline prior and structural sensitivity
objective: full-budget expected weighted retrieval cost to the existing terminal archive class
retained_record_count: Count each catalogue action once when its typed payload is an actual record in the existing record catalogue, including completeness; lookup_empty wrappers count zero. Duplicate actions each count once as specified, without treating correlated observations as independent evidence.
probabilities: Exact strictly positive rational weights on the unchanged world support; preserve coincident distributions
timing_workload: Complete reachable history tree from the initial state, branching every possible observed outcome of each selected query, with a fresh planner and empty caches per policy/problem/repetition; read-all exhausts its catalogue and other policies stop at their unchanged terminal rule
failure_handling: Preserve failed or capped computations with unavailable costs/optima and explicit missing denominators; do not replace problems or retune
sampling_inference: None: finite exact expectations, not independent incident samples
